referenceLock.$schema: workerd WebSocket reference lock (v0.3.0 T04, native Windows x64)
referenceLock.notes: Official Windows x64 asset of the same pinned source release/profile as the Linux lock. Executable and compressed digests were verified independently; neither Linux execution nor a matching version string qualifies this native asset.

provenance: Actual same-input161-case executions on both pinned official x64 assets. Fresh stacks and descriptors, native DOMException, AggregateError, Error properties/cause/cycles, non-string names, getter order and global String replacement. Raw reports retain distinct diagnostic IDs; validation checks shape/linkage/uniqueness and only then normalizes IDs. Real log references and cooperative stops are asserted by the driver.
